battle.name: 河陽之戰
battle.brief: 河陽之戰是乾元二年史思明南下解洛陽之圍、與唐九節度使聯軍在河陽白馬津對峙的一場夜戰：郭子儀力主趁叛軍遠來疲弊，選精騎夜渡黃河破其營，斬獲甚眾。卡面兵器是科林斯青銅盔，那種全正面開眼的青銅盔並不在唐軍的裝備序列裡，它的價值正在反面——視界被壓到極窄，戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 交戰的兩方是唐廷與史思明自立的燕軍。唐方在河陽一線集結的是九節度使聯軍，朔方節度使郭子儀與河中節度使李光弼為其骨幹，另有陳留、鄭州、滑州等處節度使各領本部人馬，兵額在史書上常被寫成六十萬；聯軍不設總帥，只以觀軍容使、宣慰處置使魚朝恩居中監軍，序列調度歸各節度使自行掌握。燕軍方面，主帥是自稱大燕皇帝的史思明，以精騎萬餘自魏州南下，屯兵河陽白馬津，並以游騎往來洛陽城下掠人畜；洛陽城內是安慶宗與安守忠、李歸仁等守軍，河北與塞北一帶又有契丹、奚、靺鞨等蕃人附於叛軍，構成燕軍騎兵的骨幹。唐軍步騎兼具，弩矢與糧秣自洛陽以北諸州轉運；燕軍則靠河北的就食與游騎掠奪維繫，兩套後勤體系的差別，才是這場仗真正的底色。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were the Tang court and the Yan army that Shi Siming had raised in his own name. On the Tang side the force assembled on the Heyang line was the league of nine jiedushi. Its backbone was Guo Ziyi, military commissioner of Shuofang, and Li Guangbi, military commissioner of Hedong, while the commissioners of Chenliu, Zhengzhou and Huazhou each brought contingents of their own; the headcount is usually given in the histories as six hundred thousand. The league had no commander-in-chief. A eunuch, Yu Chao'en, was appointed inspector of the army and commissioner for pacification and settlement, and the chain of command in the field remained in the hands of each jiedushi separately. On the Yan side the commander was Shi Siming, who had proclaimed himself emperor of Great Yan. He came south from Weizhou with more than ten thousand picked cavalry, stationed himself at Baima Ford on the Yellow River, and sent free-ranging riders to strip people and livestock from the country round Luoyang. Inside Luoyang were An Qingzong and the garrison officers An Shouzhong and Li Guiren. In Hebei and along the northern frontier, Khitan, Xi and Jurchen auxiliaries had attached themselves to the rebels, and they formed the backbone of the Yan cavalry. The Tang fought with foot and horse together, their crossbow bolts and provisions moving up from the prefectures north of Luoyang, while the Yan drew their supplies from Hebei and everything else from plunder. The difference between two such logistic systems was the real background to this fight.
people: 唐方的主心骨是郭子儀。他是朔方節度使、天下兵馬副元帥，出身華州，早年由武舉出身，歷安西、北庭行營，晚年以平定安史之亂著稱；為人處事不事張揚，與宦官魚朝恩同在軍中也能相安，士卒樂於用命，主帥之才大半在馭眾而非驅眾。河中節度使李光弼是契丹人，治軍精整，與郭子儀齊名，世稱郭李，他統率的河中兵是聯軍中裝備與戰鬥力最齊整的一支。九節度使聯軍不設總帥，實際上要看觀軍容使魚朝恩的臉色，這是史書屢次提到的弊病；河陽之役中，正是魚朝恩與諸節度使相互推諉，讓出兵的時機一再延誤。燕方主帥史思明是營州出身的蕃將，通六蕃語、曉騎射，先為安祿山偏將，安祿山死後與安慶宗同掌燕政，父子之間猜忌甚深，諸說並存，但他確是叛軍中最善於治軍與籠絡蕃將的一個。洛陽守將安守忠與李歸仁掌握城門，最後正是他們放棄安慶宗、開城迎唐軍。史思明之子史朝義此時尚在襁褓，繼承的影子卻已伏在河北的騎兵營裏。
peopleEn: The heart of the Tang army was Guo Ziyi. He was military commissioner of Shuofang and deputy commander-in-chief of all the imperial forces, a man out of Huzhou who had entered service through the military examination and had served in the Anxi and Beiting campaigns, and who in his later years was chiefly known as the man who ended the An Lushan rebellion. He was not a commander who advertised his own presence, and he could live at peace with the eunuch Yu Chao'en even while both were in the same camp; his soldiers were willing to die for him, and most of his talent lay in handling men rather than in throwing them away. Li Guangbi, military commissioner of Hedong, was of Khitan descent, ran his troops with strict order, and was Guo Ziyi's equal in reputation, the pair being known simply as Guo and Li; the Hedong troops he led were the best equipped and the most effective in the league. The league of nine jiedushi had no commander-in-chief and in practice answered to the face of the inspector Yu Chao'en, a defect the histories mention again and again; at Heyang it was precisely Yu's hesitations and the commissioners' mutual buck-passing that delayed the moment of departure. On the Yan side the commander was Shi Siming, a frontier chieftain's son out of Yingzhou who spoke the six foreign tongues and knew horsemanship, who had begun as a subordinate of An Lushan and after An Lushan's death had shared power with An Qingzong. Suspicion between the son and his leading general ran deep, and the sources differ on its exact shape, but Shi Siming was plainly the best of the rebel commanders at holding troops together and at winning over the frontier chieftains. The garrison officers An Shouzhong and Li Guiren held the gates of Luoyang, and it was they who finally gave up An Qingzong and opened the city to the Tang. Shi Siming's son Shi Chaoyi was then still in swaddling clothes, though the shape of his succession was already lying in wait in the cavalry camps of Hebei.
kits: 卡面這件科林斯青銅盔是公元前七世紀希臘城邦的產物，青銅鑄造，鼻脊與眼孔一體，幾乎把整張臉封在盔裡；它並沒有出現在乾元二年的河陽戰場上，但它標示的是重裝步兵頭盔的源頭形制，以及那種形制的代價：視界被壓到極窄，戴著它的人只能靠隊形活。河陽之夜的唐軍主力恰恰沒有這種全覆面的頭盔，士卒多以布巾、皮帽應戰，兜鍪與鍪鍔只配給護軍與精騎，鎧甲以皮甲、札甲為主，最講究的是明光鎧一類護心鏡；真正決定勝負的兵器是陌刀與步槊，陌刀雙刃長身，適合夜襲時近身劈砍，步槊配合弩陣封住渡口通路，弩為蹶張一類張力較大的器械，發射遲而箭重，專打騎兵。叛軍那邊是另一套裝備：骨角複合弓配羽箭，馬上用直刃刀與短桿矛，披皮甲皮冑，人馬自帶蕃馬與乾糧，騎兵作戰全靠速度與射箭的拉扯。渡河本身也要器具，唐軍夜渡黃河靠皮囊、革筏與駁船，通信靠金鼓旗幟而非號角，動靜稍大就會被游騎聽見。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is a product of the Greek city states of the seventh century BC, cast in bronze, with the nose ridge and the eye openings worked as one piece so that almost the whole face is sealed inside the shell. It never stood on the field at Heyang in the second year of Qianyuan, but it marks the fountainhead form of the heavy infantry helmet and the price of that form: the field of view is crushed to a slit, and the man wearing it can only live by his formation. The main body of the Tang army on the night at Heyang precisely had no such enclosing helmet. Rank and file went into the fight in cloth wraps and hide caps; the iron helmet with its neck guard went only to the guards and the picked cavalry. Armour was mostly hide and lamellar, with the most prized piece the Mingguang brigandine with its polished breastplate. The arms that actually decided the night were the modao, the long double-edged dao, which opened a path in close quarters during a night assault, and the foot pike, arrayed with the crossbow to seal the road to the ford. The crossbows were of the strong-drew type, slow to fire but heavy in the bolt, and told against horsemen. The rebels carried a different outfit: composite bows of horn and sinew with feathered arrows, straight-edged sabres and short thrusting spears on horseback, hide armour and hide caps, and they brought their own frontier horses and dried provisions with them, so that their fighting turned entirely on speed and on the pull of the bow. The crossing itself needed equipment too: the Tang got across the Yellow River at night on hide bags, leather rafts and light boats, and signalled by bronze drums and banners rather than by horns, for any unusual noise would have been carried by the enemy raiders.
tactics: 河陽之役的戰術核心是一次夜渡。史思明遠來河北，騎兵多而驕，既不把唐軍放在眼裏，也不防唐軍偷渡；郭子儀看中的正是這一點，選精騎夜發，分道泅渡或乘小筏過河，逼近其營，再以陌刀開路直入帳中，鼓聲一響，兩翼同時鼓噪衝營，叛軍從睡夢中驚醒，人馬踩踏，爭先渡河北撤，唐軍乘勝追擊，一直追到黃河南岸，把營壘與備用的馬匹一併奪下。叛軍的應對則是它一貫的辦法：以萬餘精騎作游騎，遠遠放箭，逼近即退，不與唐軍的步槊弩陣硬撼，專靠騎射拖住追兵；但夜襲打亂了這一節奏，營中無備，騎兵再多也無處可衝。回過神來的史思明只帶數百騎突圍，奔回魏州，河北老巢未失，這也是他後來能捲土重來的本錢。唐軍這邊的弱點不在戰術而在體制：九節度使各領一軍，互不隸屬，糧秣靠洛陽與汴河一線轉運，出兵與收兵都聽不出一個總號令，夜襲得手之後，誰也不肯乘勢追進洛陽。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Heyang was a night crossing. Shi Siming had come a long way from Hebei, and with many horsemen and much confidence he both despised the Tang army and did not expect it to cross the river against him. That was exactly what Guo Ziyi meant to exploit. He chose picked cavalry, sent them out at night, had them ford the river in parties either swimming or on small rafts, brought them up on the rebel camp, and then opened the way with modao blades straight into the tents. The first beat of the drum was the signal, and both wings roared into the camp at once. The rebels woke out of sleep in confusion, horse and man trampling each other, and they fought to cross the river ahead of the flames, while the Tang pursued them all the way to the south bank and took the camp and its spare horses along with it. The rebels' answer was their usual one: with more than ten thousand picked cavalry they rode as free raiders, loosing arrows from a distance, advancing and withdrawing, never meeting the Tang pike and crossbow line head on, and relying on mounted archery to hold the pursuers off. But a night assault scrambled that rhythm: with no preparations in camp, all the cavalry in the world had nowhere to charge. Regaining his senses, Shi Siming broke out with a few hundred riders and ran back to Weizhou with his base in Hebei untouched, and that was the capital on which he was able to come back later. The Tang weakness lay not in tactics but in organisation: the nine jiedushi each commanded their own army and were subordinate to no one, the grain came up the line from Luoyang and the Bian canal, and there was no single signal for either advancing or standing fast, so after the night raid succeeded no commander would follow it up into Luoyang.
data: 可核對的數字不多，且多帶戰報性質，須分開看。唐軍方面，舊籍與《資治通鑑》都記九節度使聯軍共六十萬，這是唐代大軍出動的慣例數，實際集結在河陽一線的兵力，較可信的判斷是十數萬。燕軍方面，記史思明自魏州南下的兵為十萬，其中以精騎萬餘充游騎，實際可用於攻取的兵力當遠少於此數。夜襲所出為唐軍精騎千人，屬精銳小股。戰果方面，舊籍記斬首萬餘級、俘虜數千、獲馬二千餘匹，數量雖大，仍不脫唐代捷報的通例；史思明僅以身免、奔回魏州一節，則是各書一致。可考的時地是：乾元二年二月，史思明屯河陽；同年十月，洛陽再失；乾元三年正月，史思明為其子史朝義與近侍所弒；寶應元年十月，唐軍再入洛陽。河陽距洛陽城約四十餘里，黃河此段水面寬廣，渡需舟筏，正是雙方僵持時的瓶頸。數十萬人的糧食一日數十萬石，全靠轉運供應，這是九節度使聯軍無法久屯的真實原因。
dataEn: Few figures can be checked, and many carry the colouring of victory reports, so they have to be separated. On the Tang side both the old histories and the Zizhi Tongjian give the league of nine jiedushi as six hundred thousand strong, which is the customary figure for a great Tang army on the move; the more defensible judgement of the force actually assembled on the Heyang line is a hundred thousand and some odd. On the Yan side the histories give the army with which Shi Siming came south from Weizhou as a hundred thousand, of whom more than ten thousand picked cavalry served as free raiders, so the strength really available for attack was much smaller. The force committed to the night raid was a thousand picked Tang cavalry, a small elite body. On results the old histories record more than ten thousand of the enemy beheaded, several thousand captured and more than two thousand horses taken; the scale is large, but it still follows the standard of Tang victory reporting, while the point that Shi Siming escaped with only his skin and ran back to Weizhou is given alike by every source. The datable points are these: in the second month of Qianyuan, two of 759, Shi Siming was stationed at Heyang; in the tenth month of the same year Luoyang was lost again; in the first month of Qianyuan three, 760, Shi Siming was killed by his own son Shi Chaoyi and a trusted attendant; in the tenth month of Baoying one, 762, the Tang entered Luoyang once more. Heyang lies about forty odd li from the city of Luoyang, the Yellow River there is broad, and a crossing requires boats and rafts, which was precisely the bottleneck while the two sides stood facing each other. Grain for several hundred thousand men runs to hundreds of thousands of piculs a day and has to be brought in by transport, and that is the real reason why the league of nine could not sit at Heyang for long.
cause: 起兵的緣由有兩層。表層是史思明要解安慶宗之困：唐廷以九節度使聯軍圍洛陽，安慶宗困守孤城，糧援將盡，史思明自魏州揮軍南下，屯兵河陽，與聯軍對峙；其公開說法是解洛陽之圍，實際上是想趁聯軍無總帥、內部不協之際，逼唐軍分兵或退兵。深一層是制度性的病根。安史之亂打了四年，唐廷靠臨時任命節度使、各路兵自將自募才勉強維持住西線，而河陽一線聚集了九個節度使的兵，卻只派一名觀軍容使監軍，沒有能統合諸軍的主帥；於是各節度使各懷算盤，既不願先出精兵，也不肯替他人斷後，糧道一長，這種共營而不共令的局面便無法持久。史思明正是看準了這一點：他不必打穿唐軍，只要把聯軍拖在河陽，等他們自散。
causeEn: There are two layers to the cause. The surface one is that Shi Siming meant to relieve An Qingzong. The Tang court had surrounded Luoyang with the league of nine jiedushi; An Qingzong was shut up in a lone city with his supplies nearly gone, and Shi Siming marched south out of Weizhou and took up position at Heyang to face the league. His public claim was that he was coming to lift the siege of Luoyang; what he actually wanted was to take advantage of a league with no commander-in-chief and with poor cooperation between its parts, and to force the Tang either to split their forces or to withdraw. Underneath lies an institutional defect. The An Lushan rebellion had run for four years, and the Tang court had held the western front together only by appointing jiedushi on the spur of the moment and letting each army recruit and command itself. On the Heyang line nine jiedushi had gathered their troops, yet the court sent only one inspector to watch them and appointed no commander capable of welding the various armies together. Each commissioner accordingly calculated his own advantage: none wished to spend his picked troops first, and none would hold the line for another, and once the grain road grew long a coalition that shared quarters but not command could not last. That is precisely what Shi Siming counted on. He did not need to break through the Tang: he only had to pin the league at Heyang and wait for it to dissolve of its own accord.
impact: 河陽之戰的影響，是一場戰術上的勝利帶出了戰略上的失敗。唐軍在夜裡偷營得手，斬獲不少，卻沒有趁勢攻下洛陽；及至秋天，聯軍各自罷兵歸鎮，數十萬兵一夕散盡，史思明回身便取洛陽，安慶忠開城迎降，叛軍的聲勢反而比戰前更盛。從戰術看，這一仗卻確立了唐軍對付史思明的一個樣本：以精騎夜渡、以陌刀近身破營，配合弩陣封路，避開與蕃騎在平原上拼消耗。史思明本人也因此把重心從救援洛陽轉為固守河北、整訓騎兵，並在乾元三年被自己人除掉，河北軍權落到史朝義手中，唐廷由此得到喘息之機，直到寶應元年再入洛陽、史朝義敗亡，安史之亂才算了結。更深一層的教訓在制度：聯軍各歸本鎮、兵不復聚，正是藩鎮割據的雛形；此後唐廷對河朔的處置從此以招安為主，河北三鎮世襲成為定制，安史之亂真正留下的並非一場戰爭的勝負，而是唐帝國權力結構的改變。
impactEn: The effect of the battle of Heyang was that a tactical victory produced a strategic failure. The Tang won the night raid and took many prisoners, but did not press on to take Luoyang; by autumn the league had broken up, each army returning to its own station, and tens of thousands of men dispersed in a single night. Shi Siming turned at once and took Luoyang, with An Qingzhong opening the gates to surrender, and the rebel cause stood higher than before the battle. Tactically, however, the engagement gave the Tang a working model for dealing with Shi Siming: picked cavalry crossing at night, modao blades opening the camp in close quarters, crossbow lines sealing the approaches, and no grumbling exhaustion on the plain against the frontier horsemen. Shi Siming himself accordingly shifted his weight from relieving Luoyang to holding Hebei and drilling his cavalry, and was then removed by his own men in the first month of Qianyuan three, 760; the military authority in Hebei passed to Shi Chaoyi, and the Tang court gained the breathing room it needed until it re-entered Luoyang in the tenth month of Baoying one, 762, and Shi Chaoyi was destroyed, after which the An Lushan rebellion was finally over. The deeper lesson lay in institutions: a league whose armies each went home to their own district and were never mustered again was the embryo of military governorship by regional commissioners, and from then on the Tang court dealt with the Hebei region by pacification and investiture, with the three Hebei commands passing by hereditary succession. What the rebellion really left behind was not the score of one war but a change in the structure of power in the Tang empire.
result: 結果是唐軍在河陽打贏了一場夜襲，卻沒有贏得這場戰役。史思明的精騎主力受創，連夜奔回魏州；唐軍斬首萬餘級、俘虜數千、奪馬二千餘匹，把史思明打回河北，卻在洛陽城下止步。史書所載最關鍵的一句仍是聯軍罷兵各歸本鎮；命令一下，九節度使的兵各回各的駐地，數十萬人散作九股，留在河南的只有各軍的殘部與看城的人。史思明抓住這個空檔，於同年十月率軍再至，攻陷洛陽，唐廷的圍城之勢一旦散伙，安史之亂又延長了三年，直至寶應元年間史朝義敗死才真正收束。對史思明而言，河陽是一記重創卻不是致命的重創，他保住了河北的兵源與根本；對唐廷而言，則是明白了一件事：在沒有總帥的聯軍裏，打贏一場夜仗很容易，把勝利變成戰果卻極難。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Tang won a night battle at Heyang without winning the war. The heart of Shi Siming's cavalry was struck and he fled back to Weizhou by night; the Tang took more than ten thousand heads, several thousand prisoners and over two thousand horses, and drove Shi Siming back to Hebei, but stopped at the foot of Luoyang. The most telling line in the histories is still that the league broke up and each army went home to its own station. Once the order was given, the troops of the nine jiedushi returned each to their own garrisons, several hundred thousand men scattered into nine streams, and only the broken remnants of each force and a few men left to watch the walls remained in Henan. Shi Siming seized that gap, came up again in the tenth month of the same year and took Luoyang; once the siege had come apart, the An Lushan rebellion dragged on for three more years, and it was not truly wound up until Shi Chaoyi was destroyed in the years of Baoying one. For Shi Siming, Heyang was a wound that was grave but not mortal: he had kept the manpower and the base of Hebei intact. For the Tang court, the lesson was this: in a league with no commander-in-chief, winning a night battle is easy, while turning that victory into results is extremely hard.
